name: Tavily
description: Search built for agents: ranked results with the text already extracted.
long_description:
Tavily's hosted server. It searches the web and returns concise, ranked results with the relevant text pulled out, and extracts a page you already have a URL for.

Bring a Tavily API key; it travels in the URL, which is how their server reads it.

auth.instructions: Create a Tavily API key and paste it here. It is sent as a query parameter, which is what this server reads.

risk.notes: Reads the public web and sends your search terms to Tavily. Nothing of yours is read.
